entities.name: Codex Etherium
entities.description: A supposedly ancient tome claimed by the Seekers of Carmot to hold the secrets of etherium, revealed to be blank.

entities.name: Seekers of Carmot
entities.description: A group who pursue carmot based on the Codex, with an academy in Vectis City.

entities.name: Etherium
entities.description: A substance whose supply the Seekers claim is running out on Esper.

entities.name: Carmot
entities.description: A mythical red stone believed to be the key to replenishing etherium.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A gifted artificer and Seeker who discovered the Codex was blank and became a planeswalker.

entities.name: Crucius
entities.description: A legendary sphinx said to have authored the Codex.

entities.name: Sharuum the Hegemon
entities.description: Crucius's consort, who confirmed the Codex was a fraud.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A planeswalker who manipulated Tezzeret with false promises.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: The shard of Alara where the Seekers operate.

entities.name: Vectis City
entities.description: The city holding the Seekers' academy.

events.summary: Tezzeret gained access to the Vault and found the Codex Etherium entirely blank.
events.quote: he discovered that the Codex Etherium was entirely blank

events.summary: The Seekers attacked Tezzeret as he tried to flee; near death, his spark ignited and he escaped Esper.
events.quote: Tezzeret's planeswalker spark ignited, and he escaped Esper

events.summary: Tezzeret confronted Sharuum, who confirmed the Codex was a fraud, and realized Nicol Bolas had manipulated him.
events.quote: This revelation helped Tezzeret realize that Nicol Bolas had manipulated him
